statements.impact_statement: CVE-2017-14159 is in slapd, the OpenLDAP server daemon: OpenLDAP 2.4.45 and earlier write slapd's PID file after dropping privileges, so a local user with access to the slapd account could change the file before a root script signals the process ID it holds (https://bugs.openldap.org/show_bug.cgi?id=8703, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2017-14159). This owner does not include slapd. The DHI openldap package for Debian 13 is built with Debian's pkg.openldap.noslapd build profile, which leaves the server out of the build; this owner publishes the client tools and libraries. Unpacked every published package of both of its builds for amd64 and arm64 (ldap-utils, libldap2, libldap-common, libldap-dev and libldap2-dev, and the debug-symbol packages of ldap-utils and libldap2): none contains slapd or any other LDAP server program, and the programs shipped are the ldap client tools such as ldapsearch, ldapmodify and ldapwhoami.
